# Independent evaluation and reporting

## Learning objective
Produce an evaluation that another analyst can inspect and reproduce.

## Content to develop
- Use the single-cell case as the final independent task.
- Complete your first review before consulting worked explanations.
- Link each judgment to a check, output, or authoritative source.
- Separate verified findings from untested concerns.

## Practice task
Copy templates/evaluation-report.qmd into your working folder and complete it alongside the evidence log.

## Checkpoint
Can another reader trace each conclusion to evidence and understand what remains uncertain?

## Deliverable
A final report, evidence log, verification scripts, and relevant outputs.

::: {.callout-note}
## Authoring status
Chapter outline ready. Add a worked example, learner instructions, verified outputs where applicable, and a collapsible explanation before release.
:::
